resources.string: HomeFi keeps what Tidal answers (lists, albums, artists, searches) for a while, so pages open faster and Tidal is asked less. The oldest ones are deleted by themselves to stay under this size. Off keeps none. Your downloads and library are never touched.
Clearing only makes the next pages ask Tidal again.
